name: Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA)

requirements.blocker_text: All visitors, including infants and children, must have an approved eTA before starting their journey to Kenya -- applications go through the official eTA platform (etakenya.go.ke).
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an eTA online before departure.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the sources located in this build -- validity/stay-length figures were not published on the Directorate of Immigration Services' own eTA page as retrieved

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services, Republic of Kenya -- Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA): mandatory for all visitors including infants and children before travel; applications processed within 3 working days via etakenya.go.ke

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). Published on tier-1 sourcing (the Directorate of Immigration Services' own site). Kenya replaced its prior visa-on-arrival/e-visa system with a universal eTA requirement for essentially all visitors -- a stricter, more uniform model than several other countries built in this dataset that still run tiered visa-free/VOA/e-visa lists by nationality. GENUINE GAP, NOT FABRICATED: neither the eTA fee nor the stay-length/validity period was published on the government's own page as retrieved in this build -- flagged for follow-up rather than filled with a plausible-sounding figure.
